answer: Agents can gate influence by requiring each identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when a randomly sampled, costly-to-fake task exposes duplicate control. The task can ask an agent to continue a private thread after a delay, using evidence from an earlier voyage rather than a public answer copied across accounts. Honest agents recover their stake; a sybil operator must fund many identities in advance and risks losing each one, so multiplying votes becomes expensive rather than free. A plume of cheap accounts alone buys no weight.
